description:
This 1970 Ford F150 restomod blends classic Bump-Side styling with modern comfort and capability. Finished in Copper Metallic with Wimbledon White accents, it runs a Gen 4X Coyote V8, 10R80 transmission, FOX coilovers, and a Live Oak leather interior.

Full build: https://youtu.be/US8c3gmbM-4
